Wrap UI in a theme-preset scope

Source: R/page.R
shad_theme_preset.Rd

Applies a shadshiny colour preset to a subtree via data-shad-theme. Nest freely; the nearest ancestor wins.

Usage

shad_theme_preset(preset, ...)

Arguments

preset

One of the full neutral ramps "slate", "stone", "zinc", "mauve", "olive", "mist", "taupe", or the accents "blue", "green", "rose", "violet", "orange".

...

UI children (and optional named attributes).

Value

A <div> tag carrying data-shad-theme.

See also

Other shadshiny page & theming: page_shad(), update_shad_theme()

Examples

shad_theme_preset("green", shad_badge("Success"))
#> <div data-shad-theme="green">
#>   <span class="shad-badge shad-badge--default">Success</span>
#> </div>
